name: Horror of the Howling Hag
description: Find your companions, defeat the Howling Hag, and end her ritual.

objectives.description: Remove all 5 Time tokens from the Arcane Circle.

specialRules.description: This adventure has no Start tile. The Arcane Circle serves as the starting location. Encounter Cards referring to a Start tile are discarded and replaced.
When the Howling Hag would be placed by a Monster draw and she is already in play, teleport her to the newly revealed tile instead.
When the Arcane Circle is revealed, place 5 Time tokens there. A Hero starting and ending their Hero Phase on the Arcane Circle removes 1 Time token.

introText: The Howling Hag has scattered the Heroes through the crypts while she completes a ritual.
victoryText: The Howling Hag is defeated and the ritual is broken! The crypts fall silent once more.
defeatText: The Howling Hag's ritual completes, and Castle Ravenloft grows darker still. The Heroes are lost to the crypts.
